prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Extreme wide shot. Still grey water reaching every horizon under a flat grey sky, and in the foreground figures in silhouette, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot, at a dark square opening in rough pitch-black timber, their backs to the camera. Grey day, flat light. Empty and waiting. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
